correctness.rationale: PASS. Conditional reflection principle gives the erfc CDF. Early positive sign follows from positive mass D>mean and Gaussian tail dominance; late negative sign uses strict Jensen and dominated convergence or Fatou for infinite E[D^-1/2]. Differentiation of K(y)=E[D^-1/2 exp(-y(1/D-1/mean))] is valid for positive y despite singular diffusivities; K''(y)>0. With both endpoint values above 1/sqrt(mean) and a dip below (from the two CDF endpoint signs), strict convexity gives precisely two simple roots and hence two strict nondegenerate CDF extrema, a single intervening zero, and exact a² scaling. Strict diffusivity-curvature Jensen gives the d-/d+ bracket. Independent SymPy differentiation and singular-law integral/crossover tests support the computations; no finite test substitutes for the convexity proof.
